headline: Avianca will invest 3,000 million dollars in Colombia
summary: Avianca announced a $3 billion investment in Colombia, according to vice president José Manuel Restrepo, after meeting with airline president Gabriel Oliva.
why: Avianca is a major Latin American airline based in Colombia, and large investments can affect aviation capacity, jobs and infrastructure in the region.
original_headline: Avianca invertirá 3,000 millones de dólares en Colombia
